summary: Quick frontend-only retest of the iteration_4 player issues (mobile viewport 375x667, MAC 18:41:B9:44:28:D3). All passed. Channel 1 (A&E FHD H.265) started playing after about 6s. After tapping Next, channel 2 (A&E) reached readyState 4 and paused=false, its clock advanced (2.5s after about 5s) and the loading overlay cleared. Before the fix it stayed stuck at paused=true and currentTime=0. Play/pause works: pause sets video.paused=true, the icon switches to 'play' and the controls stay visible while paused. Resume continues playback and the icon switches back to 'pause'. The controls hide about 4s after playback starts and again about 4s after resume.
critical_code_review_comments: player.tsx: the 1s watchdog calls player.play() while phase is 'loading' and fresh. The play/pause onPress no longer calls bumpControls. The icon and the controls-visibility effect both use reallyPlaying (isPlaying && phase==='playing'). The implementation matches the iteration_4 recommendations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL key in frontend/.env. Set localStorage iptv_device_mac and iptv_device_pin, then open /browser and tap the first [data-testid^=channel-item-]. Poll the video element's currentTime, paused and readyState together with [data-testid=player-loading]. To test auto-hide, move the mouse off the controls; leaving the pointer over the button made the controls look like they never hid.
rca_of_issue: Iteration_4 root cause (a source change did not emit statusChange readyToPlay on web) is fixed: the watchdog's repeated play() calls start the new source.
